hooks.name: Aximo: test the completed task
hooks.description: When a spec task is marked complete, run its acceptance criteria as an Aximo end-to-end test.

action.prompt: A spec task was just marked complete. Use the aximo test-what-you-built skill: find the task that just changed to [x] in .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md, collect its acceptance criteria, show me the Aximo prompt and ask before dispatching. One session for this task only.
